tests.description: SQL over the metadata corpus: retrieval, --check gates, --dry-run previews, and the refusal posture.

steps.description: A tag census: json_each reaches into array values, plain SQL aggregates.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query "SELECT t.value tag, count(*) n FROM docs, json_each(docs.tags) t GROUP BY tag ORDER BY n DESC, tag" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: Every declared collection is a view, so the dangling-author rule joins FROM authors and --check turns the row into exit 1.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query -c test/fixtures/collections/manni.config.yaml --check "SELECT d._path, d.author FROM docs d LEFT JOIN authors a ON a.slug = d.author WHERE d.author IS NOT NULL AND a._path IS NULL"

steps.description: The no-config fallback: the same rule as a path self-join over bare inputs.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --check "SELECT d._path, d.author FROM docs d LEFT JOIN docs a ON a.slug = d.author AND a._path LIKE '%authors%' WHERE d._path LIKE '%query/docs%' AND d.author IS NOT NULL AND a._path IS NULL" test/fixtures/query/docs test/fixtures/query/authors

steps.description: Duplicate slugs, the GROUP BY ... HAVING shape of the same gate.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --check "SELECT slug, count(*) n FROM docs GROUP BY slug HAVING n > 1" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: --dry-run previews a mutating statement: the exact diff, files untouched, exit 0.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --dry-run "UPDATE docs SET reviewed = 'todo' WHERE reviewed IS NULL AND _present = 1" test/fixtures/query/docs
runShell.stdio: /reviewed: \(unset\) -> todo[\s\S]*dry run; run again without --dry-run to apply/

steps.description: DROP TABLE refuses by name and points at the statements that do the real jobs (exit 2).

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query "DROP TABLE docs" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: A named check in config: a bare validate over the declared collection runs it, and -f github annotates the offending line of the offending file.
A check may read a collection as a view: FROM guides finds the guide with no owner and leaves the blog post alone.
A run scoped by positional paths skips checks with one stderr notice, so a half-corpus never answers a corpus question.

runShell.stdio: corpus checks skipped: run is scoped

steps.description: --collection is scoped too: the notice names the collections the run was narrowed to, and the guides check does not run.

runShell.stdio: corpus checks skipped: run is scoped to collections guides

steps.description: query --check -f github: the ad-hoc spelling of the same findings pipeline.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --check "SELECT _path AS path, 'duplicate slug ' || slug AS message FROM docs WHERE slug IN (SELECT slug FROM docs GROUP BY slug HAVING count(*) > 1)" test/fixtures/query/docs -f github

steps.description: --param binds a runtime value into the gate; the row comes back and --check exits 1.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --check --param author=ghost "SELECT _path FROM docs WHERE author = :author" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: -f csv prints result rows as CSV, header row first.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query -f csv "SELECT _path, title FROM docs WHERE _present = 1 ORDER BY _path" test/fixtures/query/docs
